answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 33699 Country: India Title: I have noticed that the Muslims from the countries such as India, Pakistan and Bangladesh tend to pray fardh in namaz of course Question: I have noticed that the Muslims from the countries such as India, Pakistan and Bangladesh tend to pray fardh in namaz of course but they also pray particular sunnahs for say Zuhr and Maghrib. However, many of me fellow Muslim friends that come from the middle east say Lebanon, Iran or Turkey etc pray only fardh for namaz. Please clear this concept. Answer ID: 33699 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/1301/M=1432) One should offer those nafl and sunnah salah that are reported in Hadith to be offered before and after the fardh. The insistence on leaving sunnah mu'akkadah will cause sin and admonition. The sunnah and nafl are complementary for fardh. It is not enough to content oneself with fardh only. It is good that the Muslims of India, Pakistan, Bangladesh regularly offer sunnah. The Muslims of other countries too should do so. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
